# optimizelycmp_folder (Resource)

A folder in the CMP asset library. Destroying it deletes the folder through the API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "optimizelycmp_folder" "brand" {
  name = "Brand"
}

resource "optimizelycmp_folder" "logos" {
  name             = "Logos"
  parent_folder_id = optimizelycmp_folder.brand.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Folder name.

### Optional

- `parent_folder_id` (String) ID of the parent folder. Omit to place the folder at the root; removing it later moves the folder back to the root.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (ISO 8601 UTC).
- `id` (String) Folder ID.
- `modified_at` (String) Last modification time (ISO 8601 UTC).
- `path` (String) Folder location, e.g. /images/icons.
